api:
<Piper data={samples} calcium={|w: &Water| w.ca} magnesium={|w: &Water| w.mg} sodium={|w: &Water| w.na_k}
    bicarbonate={|w: &Water| w.hco3} sulfate={|w: &Water| w.so4} chloride={|w: &Water| w.cl} group={|w: &Water| w.aquifer} />
PropTypeDefault
calcium, magnesium, sodiumFn(&T) -> f64: cations in meq/L; sodium is Na⁺ + K⁺required
bicarbonate, sulfate, chlorideFn(&T) -> f64: anions in meq/L; bicarbonate is HCO₃⁻ + CO₃²⁻required
name, group, point_size, legendas on <Ternary>

Each sample is drawn three times: in the cation triangle, in the anion triangle, and in the diamond, at its Na⁺+K⁺ share against its SO₄²⁻+Cl⁻ share. The tooltip lists all six ion shares.

examples.title: Three aquifers
examples.description: Cations bottom left, anions bottom right and both projected into the diamond; hover a point for its ion shares.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn aquifers() {
    let data = use_signal(basin());
    rsx! { <Piper data={data} calcium={|w: &Water| w.ions[0]} magnesium={|w: &Water| w.ions[1]} sodium={|w: &Water| w.ions[2]} bicarbonate={|w: &Water| w.ions[3]} sulfate={|w: &Water| w.ions[4]} chloride={|w: &Water| w.ions[5]} name={|w: &Water| w.site.as_ref()} group={|w: &Water| w.aquifer} class="h-[480px]" /> }
}

examples.title: Seawater intrusion
examples.description: Fresh water turning into seawater moves across every panel.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn seawater_mixing() {
    let data = use_signal(
        (0..=10u64)
            .map(|step| {
                let t = step as f64 / 10.;
                let fresh: [f64; 6] = [4.5, 1.2, 0.6, 5.2, 0.6, 0.5];
                let sea: [f64; 6] = [10., 53., 470., 2.3, 56., 545.];
                Water {
                    site: format!("{}% sea", step * 10).into(),
                    aquifer: "Mix",
                    ions: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
                        .map(|ion| (sea[ion] - fresh[ion]).mul_add(t * t * 0.1, fresh[ion])),
                }
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    );
    rsx! { <Piper data={data} calcium={|w: &Water| w.ions[0]} magnesium={|w: &Water| w.ions[1]} sodium={|w: &Water| w.ions[2]} bicarbonate={|w: &Water| w.ions[3]} sulfate={|w: &Water| w.ions[4]} chloride={|w: &Water| w.ions[5]} name={|w: &Water| w.site.as_ref()} point_size={7.} class="h-[480px]" /> }
}

examples.title: Wet and dry seasons
examples.description: The same wells in two seasons.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn seasons() {
    let mut all = waters("Wet season", [3.5, 1.0, 1.0, 4.0, 0.8, 0.7], 12, 7);
    all.extend(waters("Dry season", [4.5, 1.6, 2.4, 4.8, 1.8, 2.2], 12, 8));
    let data = use_signal(all);
    rsx! { <Piper data={data} calcium={|w: &Water| w.ions[0]} magnesium={|w: &Water| w.ions[1]} sodium={|w: &Water| w.ions[2]} bicarbonate={|w: &Water| w.ions[3]} sulfate={|w: &Water| w.ions[4]} chloride={|w: &Water| w.ions[5]} group={|w: &Water| w.aquifer} class="h-[480px]" /> }
}
